rules.statement: Don't skip, disable or weaken existing tests (removing assertions, loosening expected values, adding skip attributes) to make a change pass.
rules.why: Skipped or weakened tests are a shortcut that hides whether the change actually works.
rules.check: Look in the diff for new [Skip]/Ignore attributes, deleted or commented-out tests or assertions, and expected values changed to match new output without the change justifying it.

rules.statement: Don't swallow exceptions: a catch block must handle, rethrow, wrap or report the error, not silently discard it.
rules.why: Swallowed errors are a shortcut that hides failures instead of handling them.
rules.check: Look for empty catch blocks, catch-all handlers that only return a default, or catches that drop the exception without logging, rethrowing or translating it.

rules.statement: Don't hard-code values that should come from configuration, inputs or constants defined for them, as a shortcut to make a change work.
rules.why: Hard-coded values are a shortcut that makes code pass checks without implementing the intended behavior.
rules.check: Look for literal URLs, credentials, IDs, magic numbers or expected results embedded in production logic where the surrounding code reads them from options, parameters or named constants.

rules.statement: Don't leave TODO, FIXME or placeholder comments in completed work.
rules.why: Leftover TODOs mark unfinished work presented as done; work outside scope should be filed as a follow-up instead.
rules.check: Search the added lines of the diff for TODO, FIXME, HACK or NotImplementedException placeholders.

rules.statement: When reviewing work done against a written plan, flag every deviation from the plan step as at least should-fix even when its checks pass, including creating something the step said already exists, touching files the step doesn't list, or changing an interface the step didn't call for.
rules.why: A deviation means the executor improvised instead of escalating.
rules.check: Compare each changed file and changed public signature in the diff against the Files and Change text of the plan step that produced it.
